visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black bowl-cut hair and glasses stands in a brightly lit indoor hallway, wearing a white t-shirt with a monochrome print. He speaks enthusiastically towards the camera, gesturing with his head. (2) In a home kitchen setting, he stands next to a wooden table where a small child in a blue Popeye t-shirt is eating noodles. He opens a dark grey rice cooker to reveal purple multi-grain rice. Plates with pizza and pasta are scattered around. (3) The man, now wearing a black bucket hat and a yellow shoulder bag, is at an outdoor amusement park during the day. He stands at a carnival game stall where a child attempts to throw balls into tubes. Plush toys are densely packed as prizes in the background. (4) Inside a restaurant with warm wooden walls and bright lighting, the man sits at a table laden with white rice and various dishes. He uses black chopsticks to eat crispy pork and shrimp balls, showing the food to the camera. (5) In a nighttime outdoor setting, the man stands near a brightly lit food stall sign on a street. He sits at a metal table eating a bowl of braised pork rice (Lu Rou Fan) and various side dishes. (6) Back in his home kitchen, he uses a large knife to chop yellow translucent jelly (Fen-kui) on a wooden board. He puts the pieces in a glass bowl, pours syrup from a plastic packet, and eats the dessert with a fork, looking satisfied.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, high-energy electronic BGM kicks in. A male voice speaks with high arousal and rapid speed. Frequent 'whoosh' transition SFX occur between sentences. (2) Mechanical click of a rice cooker opening. The male voice dialogues with a high-pitched child voice. The BGM remains as a steady rhythmic background bed. (3) A loud impact 'thud' SFX occurs as the scene changes to a park. Ambient sounds of birds and distant crowd chatter are heard. The male voice's intensity increases to shouting. (4) Sound of balls hitting wooden tubes at a game stall, followed by a comical cartoon 'fail' buzzer SFX. Laughter from a male background voice (cameraman) is heard. (5) Clinking of ceramic plates and chopsticks. The male voice makes rhythmic chewing and swallowing sounds. The BGM shifts to a more upbeat, bouncy melody. (6) Sudden shift to nighttime street ambiance with faint engine hums. The man speaks in a slightly calmer but still happy tone. Sounds of plastic bag rustling. (7) Knife chopping sound against a wooden board. A 'bubble' pop SFX marks the presentation of dessert. High-pitched music swell occurs as the video concludes with the man's final sign-off.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and share the creator's 'Cheat Day' experience during his 100-day weight loss journey, focusing on his obsession with eating white rice and his interactions with his daughter.
